root_cause_of_incompleteness.primary: Document plane identity model pins pydantic UUID4 (audit events, object labels, grants) while email-login mints deterministic uuid5 actors; job/snapshot creation therefore rejects every email-login human (422). Root-caused live 07:44-07:55 with in-process reproduction; one-line opaque_uuid relaxation landed as commit 235ad3b, remaining relaxations enumerated but deliberately not rushed into a pre-deadline deploy.
root_cause_of_incompleteness.secondary: Bedrock chain completion blocked at invalid_proposal (model proposal fails honest preflight); table data honestly limited by 87 missing inputs / 29 missing factors.
